lessons: COVERAGE-GAP fixed (CRITICAL): the BL/health employee rate was ONE row of a 12-row official table. Under-18s and old-age-pension recipients pay 0% employee contributions and disability-pension recipients pay health tax only, so the script over-deducted them by the entire amount. Added an 8-row category table plus --category. Every derived BL/health split was checked to sum exactly to the published combined rate.

STALE fixed (CRITICAL): the mortgage mix rule said at least 1/3 must be fixed-UNLINKED. The source says only 'בריבית קבועה'; a CPI-linked fixed track satisfies it. Overstating it removed the cheaper option from the borrower's choice set. The evidence snippet had been verbatim and CORRECT all along while the claim text paraphrased it wrongly, which the self-consistency gate cannot catch. Check claim-vs-snippet, not just snippet-vs-page.

Three unsourced figures removed after the Judge checked the cited page: mortgage insurance '100-300 NIS/month', 'banks decline above 40% PTI', and 'the 1/3-prime cap was removed in January 2021'. The kolzchut page contains zero occurrences of פריים, 40%, or 2021. Long-standing numbers can be unsourced; re-grep the page rather than trusting inheritance.
